info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Cross Channel Customer Workbench-spec
info.description: The Cross Channel Customer Workbench API facilitates the seamless onboarding and integration of customer data across multiple channels within the banking system. This API enables users to create and manage a comprehensive customer workbench, allowing for enhanced customer insights and engagement strategies. Typical consumers include banking and financial services developers who require tools for optimizing customer interactions and streamlining workflows. By leveraging this API, organizations can improve customer service efficiency while ensuring a cohesive experience across all banking platforms.
